content: Create a four-part open channel assembly in a new group named Channel: a horizontal rectangular base 3.6 m along X, 1.4 m along Z and 18 cm thick, centered at x=4.4 m, z=1.7 m with its bottom on the ground. Put a rectangular upright wall at each X end. Each wall is 16 cm thick along X, spans the full 1.4 m depth, and rises 95 cm above the top of the base. Their outer faces are flush with the two ends of the base. Add one 38 cm diameter ball resting on the base at its center. Keep all four parts separately editable and leave every existing object and group unchanged.
The request failed. No changes were committed.
